Everything Sightdeck wants an agent to know about this project is in this file, not in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md. The Sightdeck skill loads it while Sightdeck is switched on for the project on this machine; switched off, nothing here applies.

## Agent subrouting

- **Agents:** [agents-overview.md](agents-overview.md) lists every project agent with its role, what it is for and its file. Delegate to one with the subagent tool (`subagent_type` = its name).
- **Workflow:** [workflows.md](workflows.md) describes the stages a task goes through and which agent works which stage.
- **Areas:** [agent-routing.md](agent-routing.md), when present, says which agent is responsible for which areas.
